results.title: FCC Launches Cyber Trust Mark to Simplify Home Cybersecurity
results.description: The FCC's new Cyber Trust Mark program will introduce a shield‑shaped label that helps consumers quickly identify IoT products that meet baseline security standards, steering them toward safer smart home devices.

results.title: AI an economic equaliser, tech at its best when inclusive, democratic: Google India's Preeti Lobana
results.description: Google underscores the pivotal role of artificial intelligence in promoting economic equality and inclusivity among businesses. Preeti Lobana pointed out the essential need for small and medium enterprises to embrace digital platforms as a catalyst for India's economic growth. The article further discusses the significance of ongoing intelligence engines in refining business operations.

results.title: Electrical company that worked with British Airways to close as it enters liquidation
results.description: UK electrical contractor Freemantle Projects Ltd, that worked with Heathrow Airport, British Airways, and Jet2, has entered liquidation and is set to close.
